title: Niyama: Breaking the Silos of LLM Inference Serving
authors: Kanishk Goel; Jayashree Mohan; Nipun Kwatra; Ravi Shreyas Anupindi; Ramachandran Ramjee
research_focus: Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM serving frameworks rely on siloed infrastructure with coarse interactive-vs-batch segregation, leading to GPU under-utilisation, no fine-grained QoS differentiation, and poor handling of overload — FCFS, SJF/SRPF, and EDF each fail under either low or high load.
problem_statement.zh: 現行 LLM 服務框架以 interactive 與 batch 兩個粗粒度類別做隔離部署，導致 GPU 資源利用率低、無法支援細粒度 QoS 差異化，且在過載時表現不佳：FCFS、SJF/SRPF 與 EDF 等策略在低載或高載下各有失效情境。

key_innovation.en: A QoS-driven serving system combining: (1) dynamic chunking that opportunistically enlarges prefill chunk size by exploiting decode-deadline slack of in-flight requests, with chunk size predicted by a Vidur-profiled random forest; (2) hybrid prioritisation that linearly interpolates EDF and SRPF priorities; (3) eager relegation that proactively moves a small fraction of soon-to-violate requests into a lower-priority relegated queue to prevent cascading deadline failures under overload.
key_innovation.zh: QoS 驅動的服務系統，結合三項機制：(1) dynamic chunking——利用 in-flight 請求 decode 端的 deadline slack 機會性地放大 prefill chunk size，chunk size 由以 Vidur profile 訓練的 random forest 預測；(2) hybrid prioritization——以線性內插結合 EDF 與 SRPF 優先級；(3) eager relegation——在過載前將少數即將違反 deadline 的請求主動轉入 relegated queue，避免 deadline 違反的連鎖效應。

baselines_compared: Sarathi-Silo (SOTA siloed deployment), Sarathi-FCFS, Sarathi-EDF, Sarathi-SRPF

key_improvements.en: Up to 32% higher effective serving capacity over the Sarathi-Silo SOTA siloed deployment while meeting QoS targets; 13-32% fewer A100 GPUs needed across Azure-Code, Azure-Conv, and ShareGPT workloads. Under extreme load, reduces SLO violations by an order of magnitude vs current schedulers. Sustains zero deadline violations up to 30% higher load than Sarathi-EDF.
key_improvements.zh: 在滿足 QoS 目標下，相較 SOTA siloed 部署（Sarathi-Silo）服務容量最高提升 32%；於 Azure-Code、Azure-Conv 與 ShareGPT 三組工作負載下，A100 GPU 需求降低 13-32%。極端過載情境下 SLO 違反率較現行 scheduler 降低一個數量級；可在較 Sarathi-EDF 高出 30% 的負載下維持零 deadline 違反。

gpu_count: 1x A100 (Llama-3-8B), 2x A100 TP2 (Qwen-7B); shared cluster up to 76 GPUs in capacity study
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (random-forest chunk-size predictor; paper reports serving-capacity/SLO-violation metrics rather than predictor MAPE)
validation_workloads: ShareGPT, Azure Conv, Azure Code (Poisson arrivals over the trace prompt/decode token distributions)

scope_assumptions.en: Implemented on top of Sarathi-Serve / vLLM and tied to its chunked-prefill execution model; chunk-size predictor is a random forest trained on Vidur simulator profiles and assumes its accuracy holds in deployment; non-interactive decode length is approximated from per-application history plus two standard deviations; eager relegation assumes a tolerable fraction (about 5%) of requests can be safely degraded; evaluation limited to A100 GPUs and Llama-3-8B / Qwen-7B class models.
scope_assumptions.zh: 實作建構於 Sarathi-Serve / vLLM 之上，緊耦合於其 chunked-prefill 執行模型；chunk size 預測器為以 Vidur 模擬器 profile 訓練的 random forest，假設其在部署時準確度仍成立；非互動式請求的 decode 長度以該應用歷史平均加兩個標準差估計；eager relegation 假設可容忍約 5% 的請求被降級；評估範圍限於 A100 GPU 與 Llama-3-8B / Qwen-7B 級別模型。
